title: Double arrows : logs
symptom: AAPS displays double down arrows when there is a steep direction change in BGs, while xDrip shows only one arrow. This occurs during sensor compression or after sensor errors, and the arrows are normal in xDrip but double down in AAPS.
cause: xDrip is sending DoubleDown in the data bundle to AAPS, and AAPS does not change the arrow if provided. The issue is that xDrip transmits the arrow without treatment, while its own UI calculates the arrow differently.
fix: No fix was implemented. The maintainer suggests reporting to xDrip, and later states that xDrip should decide what to present to AAPS. The user requested AAPS to calculate the arrow itself, but the maintainer declined to have different behavior for different BG sources.
evidence_quote: xdrip is sending DoubleDown. AAPS doesn't change the arrow if provided. Report to xDrip
